# iosxe_voice_class_tls_profile (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class TLS Profile configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_tls_profile" "example" {
  tag                    = 100
  description            = "CUBE TLS Profile"
  trustpoint             = "CUBE-CERT"
  cn_san_validate_server = true
  cn_san_names = [
    {
      tag  = 1
      name = "cube.example.com"
    }
  ]
  strict_cipher = true
  sni_send      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `client_vtp` (String) Set Client Verification Trustpoint
- `cn_san_names` (Attributes List) Specify the tag of CN/SAN hostname/pattern list entry (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cn_san_names))
- `cn_san_validate_bidirectional` (Boolean) Enable CN/SAN validation for both client and server certificate
- `cn_san_validate_client` (Boolean) Enable CN/SAN validation for client certificate
- `cn_san_validate_server` (Boolean) Enable CN/SAN validation for server certificate
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `description` (String) Define the description of input options
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `sni_send` (Boolean) Include SNI extension in outbound TLS connections
- `strict_cipher` (Boolean) Use only ciphers use by SIP standards
- `tls_cipher_id` (String) Specify tls-cipher list tag
- `trustpoint` (String) Define the trustpoint name

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--cn_san_names"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cn_san_names`

Required:

- `tag` (Number) - Range: `1`-`10`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Specify the CN/SAN hostname/pattern, valid values are a FQDN or *.<domain-name>

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_tls_profile.example "<tag>"
```
